result.reason: The clause gives Customer the preferred 30-day convenience right, but does not provide the required pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. It also permits Kubient to terminate on 90 days’ notice at any time after the Initial Term, including during a committed renewal term, rather than only at the end of a term. The added immediate termination rights for payment default, security/privacy incidents, brand-safety failures, and change of control are unnecessary to implement the T4C position and materially expand the original cause-based termination regime. Several of those triggers are also undefined or ambiguous.
